about.title: About Historical Temperature Analytics Platform
about.subtitle: Professional historical temperature data query and analysis platform, providing accurate and detailed meteorological data analysis services for global users

platformIntro.title: Platform Overview
platformIntro.description1: Historical Temperature Analytics Platform is a professional meteorological data analysis tool built with modern Web technologies. We are dedicated to providing intuitive and accurate historical temperature data query and analysis services for researchers, data analysts, educators, and weather enthusiasts.
platformIntro.description2: The platform integrates authoritative meteorological data sources such as Open-Meteo, covering major cities and regions worldwide, providing detailed historical temperature records from 1940 to present, supporting multi-dimensional data analysis and visualization in daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual formats.

historicalComparison.title: Historical Temperature Comparison
historicalComparison.description: Support comparative analysis of temperatures for the same date across different years, clearly displaying temperature change trends and helping users identify climate change patterns.

globalCoverage.title: Global Data Coverage
globalCoverage.description: Covers major cities and regions worldwide, supporting queries for historical temperature data from any location through city names, coordinate positioning, and other methods.

longTermData.title: Long-term Data Records
longTermData.description: Provides detailed historical temperature records from 1940 to present, with long data time span to meet various long-term climate research needs.

professionalAnalysis.title: Professional Data Analysis
professionalAnalysis.description: Provides detailed indicators including maximum, minimum, and average temperatures, supporting statistical analysis and trend prediction, suitable for professional research use.

smartVisualization.title: Smart Visualization
smartVisualization.description: Uses modern charting technology to provide interactive data visualization, making complex meteorological data intuitive and easy to understand.

authoritativeData.title: Authoritative Data Sources
authoritativeData.description: Integrates authoritative meteorological data APIs such as Open-Meteo to ensure data accuracy and reliability, supporting academic research and commercial applications.

backend.title: Data Services
items: Smart caching system - Optimized access speed
